Container.Name: ModelHub
Container.Overview: Self-hosted, open 3D print file library manager: STL/3MF/OBJ/STEP/FBX organization, thumbnails, duplicate detection, tagging, semantic search, smart collections, filament inventory and a print queue. AI tagging/search can run against a local Ollama instance (nothing leaves your network) or an external OpenRouter/OpenAI-compatible API using your own key -- switch anytime from the in-app Settings tab. Point "Library Path" at the share where your STL/3MF files already live; nothing is modified on disk, files are only read and hashed. On first open you'll be asked to create an admin login (or set Admin Username/Password below to skip that screen). Also includes print time/filament weight estimates, a browser extension for one-click import from Printables/ MakerWorld, and optional webhook notifications (ntfy/Discord/Slack).
Container.Changes: ### 1.0.0 Initial release. STL/3MF/OBJ/FBX live viewer, AI auto-tagging + semantic search (local Ollama or API), smart collections, filament inventory, print queue with volumetric/slicer-based estimates, session auth, webhook notifications, a Printables/MakerWorld browser extension, and PUID/PGID support so files under /config are owned by a real host user instead of root.
Container.Requires: Optional: an Ollama container (install the official "ollama" template from Community Applications first) if you want local AI instead of an API key.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Model Hub web interface

Config.Name: Library Path
Config.Description: Folder containing your STL/3MF/OBJ/STEP/FBX files. Read-only usage: files are hashed and thumbnailed, never modified.

Config.Name: App Config/DB
Config.Description: Where the SQLite database, thumbnails, and settings are stored.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Unraid's nobody user -- keeps /config editable from the host

Config.Name: Scan Interval
Config.Description: Seconds between automatic background library scans.

Config.Name: Mesh Worker Memory (MB)
Config.Description: Memory ceiling for the separate process that parses model files during scans. Leave blank for automatic (half of the container limit or host RAM, 1-8 GB). Files needing more are still indexed, from a preview (a .3mf's embedded thumbnail, or a streamed render of an STL) instead of a full parse. Raise it only if you have RAM to spare and want full stats on very large files.

Config.Name: Ollama Host
Config.Description: Address of your Ollama container/instance for local AI tagging. Only used when AI mode is set to 'local' in the app's Settings tab.

Config.Name: Ollama Vision Model
Config.Description: Vision-capable Ollama model used for auto-tagging thumbnails.

Config.Name: Ollama Embed Model
Config.Description: Ollama embedding model used for semantic search.

Config.Name: Admin Username
Config.Description: Creates the admin login automatically on first start. Leave blank to set it up from the WebUI's first-run screen instead.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Paired with Admin Username above. Leave both blank to use the in-app setup screen instead (recommended -- avoids the password sitting in plain text in the container's env).

Config.Name: Slicer CLI Path (advanced)
Config.Description: Optional: absolute path *inside the container* to a headless slicer CLI binary (e.g. an extracted PrusaSlicer/OrcaSlicer AppImage) for exact print time/filament estimates instead of the built-in volumetric approximation. Bind-mount the binary in via 'Add another Path' first, then point this at it.
